title: The Truth About Candidate Screening That Every Job Seeker Should Know
caption:
Has this ever happened to you? You spend hours perfecting an application, only to get an automated rejection within hours.

Here is what really happens with candidate screening in modern hiring pipelines. Have you experienced this in your job search? Share your thoughts below!
